cohort: The study included 191 women with singleton pregnancies who experienced preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) between 32 and 33 6/7 weeks gestational age.
finding: Antenatal corticosteroid administration in women with PPROM at 32 to 33 6/7 weeks was associated with similar maternal and neonatal outcomes, including no differences in chorioamnionitis or RDS, despite an earlier gestational age at delivery in the exposed group.
gest_age: Onset of PPROM between 32 and 33 6/7 weeks; mean gestational age at delivery was 33 2/7 weeks for exposed and 33 5/7 weeks for unexposed.
